full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg. cor EDSA Mapagmahal Street, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 35 S. March 19, 2010 MAYOR SALVADOR M. PEREZ Municipality of San Manuel Prpvince of Pangasinan Dear Mayor Perez: 2010 This pertains to your letter seeking our legal opinion on whether your plan of expanding your existing solar powered facility to include additional street lights in front of the Municipal Building, the Dr. Laureano S. Perez Memorial Clinic and the police station since these government facilities are vital and open 24 hours a day, is an undertaking contemplated under Section 294 of the Local Government Code of 1991 In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 50, series of 2003. Attached herewith is a copy of the said opinion for your ready reference. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: ATTY. JESUS B. O UE Director Ill cc: Director Manuel V. Biason Regional Director- Region 1 Poblacion Norte, Sison Pangasinan MLGOO Richard S. Real LGOO V, Guiset Sur, San Manuel Pangasinan Legal:20/corz
